interpretation: No CPV48 award rows can be joined to this month's published notices despite 84 CPV48 notice rows. Nine CPV72 matched award rows each have a different unverified supplier label. Neither result estimates supplier market concentration or tender-to-award conversion; award and publication exports cover different cohorts.
limitations: Monthly publisher cohort is not a national census.
Award rows and published tenders represent different time/cohort definitions; zero CPV48 joins is not zero CPV48 awards.
One tender can have multiple award rows; rows are not distinct tenders.
Supplier IDs are unverified publisher labels, not necessarily distinct firms.
The nine CPV72 matched award rows are too few and selection-biased for market-share inference.
CPV48 and CPV72 any-code groups overlap and must not be summed.
No customer payment, real task time saving or AgentMine revenue was measured.
